shortdesc.ph: Occurs when the SDK is ready to send metadata.

p.codeblock: public abstract byte[] onReadyToSendMetadata(long timeStampMs, int sourceType);

section.p: This callback is triggered when the SDK is ready to send metadata.
As of v4.7.1, when sourceType is VIDEO_SOURCE_TRANSCODED, return the metadata to send with the locally transcoded video stream.
As of v4.7.1, when sourceType is AgoraVideoSourceTypeTransCoded, return the metadata to send with the locally transcoded video stream.
The metadata is carried by the mixed output stream. Metadata from input camera or screen-sharing streams is not automatically merged into the output stream.
After receiving this callback, you can call to send the media metadata.
section.note: Ensure that the size of the metadata does not exceed the value set in the callback.
Ensure that the size of the metadata does not exceed the value set in the callback. If the metadata size exceeds this value, the SDK truncates the excess data.
Ensure that the metadata size does not exceed the value set in the callback, up to 1024 bytes. If the metadata size exceeds this value, the SDK truncates the excess data.

plentry.pd: The metadata that the user wants to send. See .

section.title: Returns

ul.li: : Do not send the video frame.

section.p: The metadata to send, as NSData. Return nil when there is no metadata to send.

The metadata that you want to send in the format of NSData, which includes the following parameters:
uid: The ID of the remote user who sends the metadata.
size: The size of the metadata.
buffer: The metadata data.
timeStampMs: The NTP timestamp (ms) when the metadata is sent.
The metadata to send, as a byte array. Return null when there is no metadata to send.
The metadata that you want to send in the format of byte. Ensure that you set the return value.
